item.title: Towel Storage for a Small Bathroom With No Wall Space
item.description: When a small bathroom has no free wall for a towel bar, the answer is usually not a bigger rack. It is a clearer split of jobs: a damp towel needs air and a place to hang open, while clean spares need a dry place to wait. Once those two needs have separate homes, the room gets easier to use. This guide starts with a towel count, then measures the door, the floor and the cabinet fronts before comparing options.
